mentions.name: Psikat
mentions.description: A tracker-like sequencer/DAW that runs in the browser, built as a middle ground between clip-based DAWs and traditional trackers, designed for comfortable music production from a keyboard. It keeps the tracker workflow familiar to DAW users while staying lean on features.
mentions.problem: Typical clip-based DAWs feel clunky and uncomfortable when working from a keyboard, and existing trackers feel too far removed from what DAW users are used to or carry far more features than needed.
